newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH ZREW TO START BOURSE TRADE MAY 7.
newsitem.headline: POLISH ZREW TO START BOURSE TRADE MAY 7.

text.p: Polish power equipment repairer Zaklady Remontowe Energetyki Warszawa SA (ZREW) will start bourse trade on the parallel market on May 7, the bourse's president said on Wednesday.
"The first listing of Zaklady Remontowe Energetyki Warszawa will take place on the bourse's session on May 7," Wieslaw Rozlucki said after the bourse's session.
The company, which 778,496 shares will be listed on the exchange, did not carry out an initial public offering.
